say:1:1530142001:0.text: Then I can fight on the battlefield and drive out those evil Halians!
say:1:1530142001:0.source_cn: 成为战士，就可以上战场，抵抗可恶的呼临人！
say:1:1530142001:0.male: Then I can fight on the battlefield and drive out those evil Halians!
say:1:1530142001:0.female: Then I can fight on the battlefield and drive out those evil Halians!

say:2:1530142002:0.text: They seized our lands and took Mirehold. They'll pay for that!
say:2:1530142002:0.source_cn: 他们侵犯我们的领地，还占领了水泽营地，罪不可恕！
say:2:1530142002:0.male: They seized our lands and took Mirehold. They'll pay for that!
say:2:1530142002:0.female: They seized our lands and took Mirehold. They'll pay for that!

say:3:1530142003:0.text: Only when they're gone will the Wildborn know peace again!
say:3:1530142003:0.source_cn: 只有赶跑他们，雅库伯尔才能重新恢复平静！
say:3:1530142003:0.male: Only when they're gone will the Wildborn know peace again!
say:3:1530142003:0.female: Only when they're gone will the Wildborn know peace again!
